name: How long does a typical damaged flooring replacement project take in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical damaged flooring replacement project take in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a damaged flooring replacement project varies based on the type of flooring, the size of the area, and the extent of subfloor preparation required. For a standard room (e.g., 200-300 sq ft) with minimal subfloor issues, projects can range from 2-5 days for materials like laminate or engineered wood. Hardwood installations or projects involving extensive subfloor repairs or custom tile work may take longer, potentially 1-2 weeks. We provide a detailed timeline during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies, typically 2-5 days for standard rooms with common materials, or up to 1-2 weeks for larger areas or complex installations.
